footer.tagline: Websites and AI for businesses in Flemish Brabant and Brussels.

bern.name: Bern
bern.welcome: Hi! I'm Bern. How can I help? Pick a question below, or send your question straight to Gerben.

questions.q: How much does a website cost?
questions.a: A new custom website starts from € 1,850; redesigning an existing site from € 950. Always a fixed price, agreed up front.

questions.q: What can AI do for my business?
questions.a: For example, smart search across your own documents, or an assistant that drafts your quotes. Gerben always starts with a free feasibility call.

questions.q: How soon will my site be ready?
questions.a: A new website usually takes 3 to 5 weeks. You see progress along the way.
